cards.front: healthy
cards.back: Feeling well and strong, with a body that works well.
cards.say: healthy. Feeling well and strong, with a body that works well.

cards.front: exercise
cards.back: Moving your body, such as running, swimming or playing. It makes your heart and muscles strong.
cards.say: exercise. Moving your body, such as running, swimming or playing. It makes your heart and muscles strong.

cards.front: sleep
cards.back: Rest at night. Your body grows and mends while you sleep.
cards.say: sleep. Rest at night. Your body grows and mends while you sleep.

cards.front: hygiene
cards.back: Keeping clean so germs do not make you ill.
cards.say: hygiene. Keeping clean so germs do not make you ill.

cards.front: germs
cards.back: Tiny living things that can make you ill. We cannot see them.
cards.say: germs. Tiny living things that can make you ill. We cannot see them.

cards.front: fruit and vegetables
cards.back: Healthy foods. They help your body grow and fight illness.
cards.say: fruit and vegetables. Healthy foods. They help your body grow and fight illness.

cards.front: Why do we need to eat healthy food?
cards.back: It gives us energy and helps us grow.
cards.say: Why do we need to eat healthy food? It gives us energy and helps us grow.

cards.front: Which is healthier: an apple or a sweet?
cards.back: An apple. Sweets have a lot of sugar.
cards.say: Which is healthier: an apple or a sweet? An apple. Sweets have a lot of sugar.

cards.front: Why do we need exercise?
cards.back: It makes our heart and muscles strong.
cards.say: Why do we need exercise? It makes our heart and muscles strong.

cards.front: Name three kinds of exercise.
cards.back: Running, swimming and jumping. There are many more.
cards.say: Name three kinds of exercise. Running, swimming and jumping. There are many more.

cards.front: Why do we need sleep?
cards.back: Sleep lets our body rest and grow.
cards.say: Why do we need sleep? Sleep lets our body rest and grow.

cards.front: How many hours of sleep does a child need?
cards.back: About nine to eleven hours each night.
cards.say: How many hours of sleep does a child need? About nine to eleven hours each night.

cards.front: When should we wash our hands?
cards.back: Before we eat and after we use the toilet or play outside.
cards.say: When should we wash our hands? Before we eat and after we use the toilet or play outside.

cards.front: Why do we wash our hands with soap?
cards.back: Soap helps remove germs from our hands.
cards.say: Why do we wash our hands with soap? Soap helps remove germs from our hands.

cards.front: Why do we brush our teeth?
cards.back: To keep them clean and strong. It stops tooth decay.
cards.say: Why do we brush our teeth? To keep them clean and strong. It stops tooth decay.

cards.front: How often should we brush our teeth?
cards.back: Two times a day, in the morning and at night.
cards.say: How often should we brush our teeth? Two times a day, in the morning and at night.

cards.front: Why should we cover our mouth when we cough?
cards.back: So germs do not spread to other people.
cards.say: Why should we cover our mouth when we cough? So germs do not spread to other people.

cards.front: Which keeps you healthy: sitting all day or playing outside?
cards.back: Playing outside. It gives you exercise.
cards.say: Which keeps you healthy: sitting all day or playing outside? Playing outside. It gives you exercise.

cards.front: Why do we have a bath or shower?
cards.back: To wash off dirt and germs.
cards.say: Why do we have a bath or shower? To wash off dirt and germs.

cards.front: Which drink is best for you?
cards.back: Water.
cards.say: Which drink is best for you? Water.

cards.front: Is a lot of sugar good for your teeth?
cards.back: No. Sugar can make teeth decay.
cards.say: Is a lot of sugar good for your teeth? No. Sugar can make teeth decay.

cards.front: Why should we eat different kinds of food?
cards.back: Different foods give our body different things it needs.
cards.say: Why should we eat different kinds of food? Different foods give our body different things it needs.

cards.front: Why do we wear a helmet on a bicycle?
cards.back: It protects our head and keeps us safe.
cards.say: Why do we wear a helmet on a bicycle? It protects our head and keeps us safe.
